_how_to_use: Training courses shown on /training/. One entry per course. Summaries are written in our own words from the provider's page. 'fees' lists amounts exactly as the provider publishes them (label + amount, GST as stated in 'fees_note'); leave it empty when the provider doesn't publish fees and say where to find them in 'fees_note'. 'accreditation' lists recognition stated by the provider (CPD hours, registration hours, WSQ, recognised programmes). 'grants' lists each funding scheme with who qualifies, as the provider states it. 'funding' holds the matching filter ids. 'next_date' is the start of the next confirmed run (YYYY-MM-DD) or null; 'next_run' is the text shown. 'checked' is when someone last opened the provider's page.
